why: Holmes is said to have brooded for 'a whole day' before this morning, and Watson's question 'Why didn't you go down yesterday?' places that day on Wednesday.
The story opens at breakfast (¶1), and ¶13 explicitly says it is Thursday morning.
¶6 says they must catch their train at Paddington, and ¶7 says Holmes procured the papers there, so the scene is set at Paddington before departure.

text: Thursday morning, in the train from Paddington
why: ¶7 has them already flying along toward Exeter in a first-class carriage after leaving Paddington.

text: Thursday morning, the train passing Reading
why: ¶7 says 'We had left Reading far behind us' before the papers were put away, so the train has passed Reading earlier in the same morning.

text: Thursday morning, in the train well past Reading
why: ¶7 states they had left Reading far behind, and ¶8 describes them travelling at speed, so the time is well past Reading.
